in_arabic.name: شهيما
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم شهيما مشتق من الجذر العربي ش-ه-م، ويعني الحبيبة أو المحبوبة. يدل على معنى الحب والشوق، وغالباً ما يوصف به الأشخاص الذين يحملون صفات جميلة ومحببة

in_urdu.name: شہیمہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: شہیمہ نام عربی جڑ ش-ہ-م سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے محبوبہ یا پیاری۔ یہ نام پیار اور لگن کے احساس کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور اکثر ان افراد کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو خوبصورت اور قابل محبت خصوصیات کے حامل ہوتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: शहीमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: शहीमा नाम अरबी मूल श-ह-म से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रिय या प्यारी। यह नाम प्रेम और स्नेह की भावना को दर्शाता है, और अक्सर उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो सुंदर और प्रिय गुणों के धारक होते हैं

in_pashto.name: شهیما

in_english.name: Shaheema
in_english.meaning: Loved one, beloved, or cherished person
in_english.long_meaning: The name Shaheema originates from the Arabic root 'ش-ه-م' (sh-h-m), which conveys the meaning of a loved one, beloved, or cherished person. This name signifies love, affection, and endearment. In Islamic tradition, names are chosen for their meanings and spiritual significance. Shaheema, with its beautiful connotation, reflects desirable qualities such as compassion, kindness, and warmth. Historically, names like Shaheema have been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the importance of love and relationships in Islamic values

data.cultural_impact: The name Shaheema holds great cultural significance, reflecting the values of Islamic tradition. In Arabic, the name is derived from the words "sh-h-m" which mean "noble" and "beautiful," while "a" is an article denoting femininity. This name is a reminder of the ideal Muslim woman who embodies strength, dignity, and grace. Throughout history, Muslim women have strived to uphold the values of modesty, intelligence, and compassion, which are encapsulated in the name Shaheema. In contemporary contexts, this name continues to be a popular choice for parents, symbolizing their aspirations for their daughter.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Shaheema is also deeply rooted in spiritual meanings. In Islamic tradition, beauty is often regarded as a reflection of the inner character, with the Quran emphasizing the importance of external and internal adornment. Similarly, nobility and graciousness are attributes of the Prophet Muhammad, who is the exemplar of good character for all Muslims. By giving the name Shaheema, parents are expressing their hope that their daughter will possess these virtuous qualities, both externally and internally. Ultimately, the name is a reminder of the importance of striving for inner and outer beauty, and being a noble and gracious individual, in accordance with Islamic teachings.
